note: Seylan Bank's Mastercard Freedom credit card: 28.00% a year from 1 July 2026, and no fee but a maintenance charge of 1,500 rupees in a billing cycle with less than 10,000 rupees spent, written as a monthly fee waived on that spending.

sources.title: Seylan Bank, Mastercard Freedom Credit Card (rendered)
sources.said: The card has a spend commitment of LKR 10,000.00 per month. If Spend Commitment is not met a maintenance charge of LKR 1,500.00 will be recovered. ... Interest Rate %p.a. 28.00% p.a (w.e.f. 01 July 2026)
